content.introduction: The Economic Calendar on Investing.com tracks indicators such as GDP, inflation, employment figures, interest rate decisions, manufacturing PMI, consumer confidence, and central bank speeches from countries around the world. The calendar highlights high-impact events like central bank interest rate decisions, Non-Farm Payrolls (NFP), GDP releases, the Consumer Price Index (CPI), and unemployment data, marked with three stars. On TradingView, the Economic Calendar shows the latest and upcoming economic events affecting assets, regions, and global markets, customizable to weekly or US-specific events. Trading Economics' Economic Calendar provides events for 196 countries including data releases for 300,000 economic indicators, actual values, consensus figures, and proprietary forecasts.
body:
The Economic Calendar is a real-time, streaming schedule of economic events and data releases that can move financial markets. It tracks indicators such as GDP, inflation, employment figures, interest rate decisions, manufacturing PMI, consumer confidence, and central bank speeches from countries around the world.

### What do the star icons next to each event mean? [...] The highest-impact events include central bank interest rate decisions, Non-Farm Payrolls (NFP), GDP releases, the Consumer Price Index (CPI), and unemployment data. These are typically marked with three stars on the calendar because they can cause significant volatility across forex, equities, commodities, and bond markets. Filtering by high importance is a quick way to focus on the releases most likely to move prices.

# Calendar

## How to use Economic Calendar

Economic Calendar on TradingView shows the latest and upcoming economic events that can affect certain assets, regions, and global markets — for example, stocks, Forex, or bonds. [...] All events are in chronological order and linked with economic indicators like interest rates or GDP. The calendar is customizable: one click will give you a weekly economic calendar, another — narrow it down to US economic calendar only. Plus, you will see short explainers of the events and forecasts from experts. Just set your calendar and prepare for the next trade.

Learn more about the Economic Calendar features in our Help Center.
